hook: Telangana got *1.27 cm* of rain in October. Normal is 9 cm
hook_b: Murasu brings rain today. Does it fix the dry season?
tldr: October rain fell 86% short in Telangana; experts see November short too, cyclone aside.

beats.what: Telangana logged 1.27 cm of rain in October against a normal 9.01 cm.
beats.why: Rain has been below normal for five straight months since the southwest monsoon.
beats.care: Weaker borewells and lakes ahead. One cyclone may not refill them, officials suggest.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Per Sakshi, citing the weather department: October rain was 86% below normal (1.27 cm vs 9.01 cm). Last October the state got 17.57 cm. From June to October, Telangana got 62.82 cm against a normal 83.07 cm, a gap of 20.25 cm. That hits kharif crops, groundwater recharge and lake storage. IMD's November outlook is also below normal: the month's average is 1.57 cm, and experts expect a 25–40% shortfall, though Cyclone Murasu may push some places above normal. Days are expected to stay warmer than usual, with less winter chill.
